positions.pos: Dissolving runs down four states, densest first: ice, water, gas, pure spirit. The spirit generator's forms sit on them by density: the living creature and the highest ally form are ice, the hologram and the core are water, the gas is gas. A spirit that walks with you in the cave walks as an ally, so it is ice; one you breathed out at the W.A.V.E.'s fork walks lighter, so it is water. Each step down is one breath with one line, in the W.A.V.E.'s order: warm it (ice to water), let it rise (water to gas), breathe it in (gas to pure spirit). This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Your chat, 14 October: "Ice in this case is the current density of the charge (allies being the highest density) and charge sprites in their particle form being their gas style energy. Pure spirit is mana itself." The forms are sg-holo-stages and round 1 of the spirit art (gas, core, hologram, creature, ally form). Built in bars-engine cave/dissolve.js.

positions.pos: Each step down pays one mana, so a denser spirit pays more: ice 3, water 2, gas 1. The mana raises the stat the spirit's element grows fastest (Earth HP, Fire Power, Metal Guard, Water Magic, Wood Speed). A spirit whose feeling was never named has no element, so you pick the stat. The numbers are drafts. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Your chat, 14 October: "This is how players can increase their own stats by taking spirits into themselves instead of using them as allies". The five stats and which element grows which are spirit-five-stats. Paying more for a denser spirit makes giving up an ally you trained cost something and give something.

positions.pos: A dissolved spirit is gone, the way a dismissed one is. Before the last breath you can stop, and it stays as it was. A spirit hidden by perceptual shadow is not on the list, so you cannot dissolve it until you can see it. Your stats are kept on your phone for now. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: Your chat called dissolving "a form of dismissal", and bms-dismiss says nothing dismisses a spirit for you, so the player can always stop. The perceptual shadow thread is building how shadow hides spirits; dissolving reads only what is seen.
